transit_geometry.rule: All door transit rooms have the same geometry: from the aligned arrival column there are two live tiles to the left and two live tiles to the right; use the paired column, then move through the north-south door.

dynamic_examples: actor movement changes the old tile from occupied variant to base and the new tile from base to occupied variant
a cut bush changes obstacle 08 to floor 00
a filled bridge gap changes 02 to 00
a weighted floor switch changes 00 to 01
scope_warning: These tile-family meanings are confirmed for this cave. Promote a rule to global_engine only after evidence from other maps.
